analysis.emptyBody: Or paste one, press Choose…, or right-click a picture or video in Media → Open in Media Analysis. A video opens in the frame picker. It is read on this PC; nothing is uploaded.
analysis.unsupported: Media Analysis reads PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures, and MP4, MOV, MKV and WebM videos.
analysis.noMade: This picture carries no generation settings.
analysis.made.partial: (built at run time — this is only the part that was typed)
analysis.setupBody: Tags come from an image tagger that runs on this PC's processor, so it never takes GPU memory from your models.
analysis.setupRuntime: Set up installs a small private runtime for them (about 300 MB, kept apart from ComfyUI). Nothing else is downloaded.
analysis.noModels: No models folder is set. Choose one under Backend → Folders first.
analysis.stage.convert-environment: Setting up Python for the conversion…
analysis.stage.convert-packages: Downloading the conversion tools (PyTorch for the CPU)…
analysis.stage.convert-checking: Checking the copy against the original…
analysis.videoByPath: Videos cannot be pasted. Drop the video file here, or press Choose…
analysis.lookedIn: DEAS looked in your models folders (taggers, onnx, animetimm and any folder named for a tagger) and in ComfyUI's tagger nodes in custom_nodes. Any ONNX tagger that comes with its tag list is used where it is. If you have one somewhere else, move it into models/taggers and press Look again.
analysis.downloadOffer: Or DEAS can download one for you: WD v3 EVA02-Large ({size} GB, Apache-2.0), into your models folder under taggers.
analysis.download: Download WD v3 EVA02 and set up ({size} GB in total)
analysis.cancelled: Setup was cancelled. Nothing half-installed was kept.
analysis.taggerFromNoCategories: From {place} · {count} tags. Its tag list has no categories, so characters are recognised by DEAS's Danbooru tag list.
analysis.openComfyHelp: Loads the workflow saved in this picture into the Comfy tab, so you can see what made it.
analysis.noWorkflow: This picture carries no ComfyUI workflow.
analysis.comfyOff: Start the backend first (Backend → Start); the workflow opens in its Comfy tab.
analysis.comfyFailed: The Comfy tab did not take the workflow. Open the Comfy tab once, wait until it has loaded, then try again.
analysis.describe.title: Describe
analysis.describe.body: Your vision LLM looks at the picture and the tags above: the picture in words, who is in it, and what the tagger missed or got wrong.
analysis.describe.stopped: Stopped: this is what the model had written so far.
analysis.describe.samplingHint: Repeating itself? Try temperature 0.7 and repeat penalty 1.5, Qwen's own settings for its vision models.
analysis.describe.pickFirst: These are the models. Check the one in the list, then press Describe.
analysis.describe.noEnv: Open a DEAS environment first; Describe uses its LLM settings.
analysis.describe.noTags: Without tags the model describes the picture alone and suggests the main tags itself.
analysis.describe.reading: The model is looking at the picture…
analysis.describe.readingCast: The model is looking at the picture, with the cast of {series}…
analysis.describe.castNote: It was shown the cast of {series}, so it could name them by sight.
analysis.describe.unknownHelp: Danbooru has no such tag, so image models were not trained on it.
analysis.describe.unknownNote: {count} suggested tags are not Danbooru tags (struck through); they are left out when added.
analysis.describe.add: Add its tags to the tags above
analysis.frames.title: Frame picker
analysis.frames.strided: This clip is long, so the strip shows every {stride}th frame; the arrows still step one frame at a time.
analysis.frames.playHelp: Play the clip (K). Pausing stops on the frame on screen.
analysis.frames.cantPlay: This clip cannot be played here (the built-in player does not read its format). Step through it with ‹ › instead; the frames are still exact.
analysis.frames.useHelp: Read this frame's tags and Describe it, as a picture (Enter)
analysis.frames.pickHelp: Add or remove this frame from the picked set (Space). Ctrl-click or Shift-click frames in the strip too.
analysis.frames.saveTitle: Choose a folder for the frames
analysis.frames.sent: Frame {frame}: {action}. It is set in the Generate tab.
analysis.frames.sendGone: Generate no longer takes a picture that way; check the model chosen there.
analysis.frames.sentMany: Sent {count} frames ({frames}): {action}. They are set in the Generate tab.
analysis.frames.sendManyHelp: Sends every picked frame, in order ({count}).
analysis.frames.noSends: To send a frame to Generate (a video model's first or last frame, or H3 pictures), choose that model in the Generate tab first.
analysis.frames.privacy: Frames are read from the file with FFmpeg on this PC, frame by frame; the video is never changed or uploaded.
analysis.convert.note: Converts it once, on this PC: downloads about {tools} GB of conversion tools (PyTorch for the CPU), kept until nothing here is left to convert, then removed, and writes a {size} GB copy into DEAS's own folder. The original folder is not changed. Takes a few minutes and a lot of memory for big taggers.
analysis.convert.done: {name} is converted and ready to use.
analysis.search.needsSetup: Shown once the taggers are set up in this tab.
analysis.search.setupOnly: Shown only while the taggers are not set up yet.
analysis.search.needsPicture: Open a picture in this tab first.
analysis.search.needsVideo: Open a video in this tab first; it opens in the frame picker.
analysis.search.noConvert: Shown only for a PyTorch-only animetimm checkpoint DEAS found.
